name: Curiosity Kills (255126): Cleric Abigail resurrects the player after drinking the Bottle of Poison (#12767)
contract: Curiosity Kills (255126) gives the Bottle of Poison (item 355220, spell 355722), which hits Cleric Abigail (312414, spawn 9951028) and kills the caster with Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_INSTAKILL inside the Tarren Mill Graveyard focus (GO 255073, focus 1705).

Previously Abigail only granted quest credit (312414) on spellhit 355722 and never cast her companion Resurrection spell 355721 (Spell.dbc: 2 s cast, Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_RESURRECT_NEW, Effect[2] SPELL_EFFECT_KILL_CREDIT 312414).

Expected: after using item 355220 in phase 1 beside Abigail, the player dies, receives quest completion credit for 255126, receives SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST (opcode 347) from Abigail, and comes back alive after accepting with CMSG_RESURRECT_RESPONSE (opcode 348).

steps.label: Join the world phase of Cleric Abigail (9951028) and Tarren Mill Graveyard focus (9001652)
SETUP: Cleric Abigail is present at the graveyard
SETUP: hold the Bottle of Poison (355220)
Drink the Bottle of Poison beside Cleric Abigail
CONTROL: drinking the poison kills the player
CONTROL: Curiosity Kills (255126) is credited and complete
DISCRIMINATING: Cleric Abigail casts Resurrection (355721) and sends SMSG_RESURRECT_REQUEST
DISCRIMINATING: the player returns to life after accepting Abigail's resurrection
